detailZones.title: Triage and reception
detailZones.description: Inspect the triage counter, reception workstation, wheelchair and waiting-room fixtures.

detailZones.title: Resuscitation bay
detailZones.description: Follow the resuscitation stretcher, monitors, carts, oxygen, suction and bedside equipment.

detailZones.title: Examination bays
detailZones.description: Inspect the examination couches, curtains, wall panels, sinks, probes and waste fixtures.

detailZones.title: Clinical support
detailZones.description: Explore the nurse station, clean utility storage, pass-through and corridor hardware.

detailZones.title: Operating theatre entrance
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible operating-theatre doorway and the equipment glimpsed beyond it.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source and resized emergency-department photographs were inspected at native and final pixels. This batch retains 108 independently pointable room, equipment, fixture and visible part anchors across 5 bounded zones. Patient identity, diagnosis, medication names, procedure steps, outcomes, sterile-state claims, brands, readable screen content and hidden functions were excluded.
